tables.caption: Antimicrobial activity of acipensins Ac1, Ac2, and Ac6*
footnotes: * Data are presented as the minimum inhibitory concentration of peptides in μM; the peptides were incubated with microorganisms in a 10 mM sodium phosphate buffer, pH 7.4, in one case, and in a 10 mM sodium phosphate buffer, pH 7.4, containing 100 mM NaCl, in another case. The comparison peptides were porcine protegrin 1 (PG-1), human alphadefensin HNP-1, and goat bactenecin ChBac5.
